title: Theater
wikitext:
The '''Theater''' is the menu where players rewatch story chapters. It lists every main story Canto with its focus Sinner and release season, so it doubles as a story chapter list.

== Main story chapters ==
* Prologue: Selva Oscura (Season 1: Orientation)
* Canto I: The Outcast, focus [[Gregor]] (Season 1)
* Canto II: The Unloving, focus [[Rodion]] (Season 1)
* Canto III: The Unconfronting, focus [[Sinclair]] (Season 1)
* Canto IV: The Unchanging, focus [[Yi Sang]] (Season 2: Reminiscence)
* Canto V: The Evil Defining, focus [[Ishmael]] (Season 3: Bon Voyage)
* Canto VI: The Heartbreaking, focus [[Heathcliff]] (Season 4: Clear All Cathy)
* Canto VII: The Dream Ending, focus [[Don Quixote]] (Season 5: Oblivion)
* Canto VIII: The Surrendered Witnessing, focus [[Hong Lu]] (Season 6: Zàng Huā Yín)
* Canto IX: The Unsevering, focus [[Ryōshū]] (Season 7: Kumo no ito • oti on akA)
* Canto X: The Gaze Bearing, focus [[Meursault]] (Season 8: PUNCTUM)

== Latest chapter ==
As of October 2026, the newest main story chapter is [[Canto X]]: The Gaze Bearing, released from September 17, 2026. The newest side stories are the two Season 7 Intervallos: Twining Threads and [[Intervallo VII: Mnestic Experience]].

== Side stories ==
Intervallos released between Canto IV and Canto X include S.E.A. (Season 2); Miracle in District 20 and Yield My Flesh to Claim Their Bones (Season 3); Timekilling Time and Murder on the WARP Express (Season 4); LCB Regular Check-up and Nocturnal Sweeping (Season 5); Spring Cultivation (Season 6); and Twining Threads and Mnestic Experience (Season 7).
